one_line_summary: P1 warm inbound (Anglo American referral): Rodrigo Castillo, Head of Operations, Northern Operations Division at SQM, wants autonomous inspection to replace expensive, hazardous contracted crews at 3 large 24/7 Atacama lithium sites. FlytBase's case study shows SQM already runs FlytBase docks with Chilean integrator Adentu [S1], so treat this as an expansion of an existing account: AE-led, with Adentu as co-sell partner.

buyer_context.who: Rodrigo Castillo (r.castillo@sqm.cl), Head of Operations, Northern Operations Division, SQM, Chile. He came in through flytbase.com/contact, referred by Anglo American. He is a senior operations owner, but his budget authority is not confirmed. Research found no public record of him or of a 'Northern Operations Division'. Since 27 Dec 2025 the Atacama lithium operations sit inside Nova Andino Litio (Novandino), the Codelco-SQM joint venture [S7][S33], so he may sit in SQM or in Novandino.
what_he_cares_about: Cutting the cost of contracted inspection crews across 3 large sites that run 24/7 (his own word: 'expensive')

Getting people off hazardous outdoor rounds. The labour authority describes the SQM Salar site at about 2,300 m with outdoor workers exposed to large thermal swings, and partially suspended work there in Feb 2026 [S30][S31]
Having a fundable case ready for the internal budget conversation he mentioned for Q3
Reliability at operations running at full capacity [S19], in harsh desert conditions (heat, dust, wind, connectivity) [S30]

top_3_research_highlights.finding: Per FlytBase's case study, SQM already runs DJI Dock drones on FlytBase with Chilean integrator Adentu across a 678 km² operation in northern Chile, sending RGB and thermal data to SQM's Azure environment over Starlink. It reports >95% mission reliability, a total investment of USD 70-80k with ROI in under a year, and extra docks ordered for 24/7 security surveillance.
top_3_research_highlights.why_ae_should_care: This is an expansion of an existing account, not a cold start. Desert reliability, Azure integration, local delivery and payback are already proven inside SQM and give Rodrigo numbers for his budget case. Caveat: the existing program is iodine/nitrate under the digital innovation team, not lithium.

top_3_research_highlights.finding: Since 27 Dec 2025 the Atacama lithium operations are run by Nova Andino Litio (Novandino), the Codelco-SQM joint venture holding them until 2060, with a joint Codelco/SQM board and a Codelco-designated finance manager (Eduardo Foix). SQM consolidates Novandino until 2030; Codelco holds 50% plus one share afterwards.
top_3_research_highlights.why_ae_should_care: The contracting entity and approvers are probably Novandino, not SQM S.A. Expect extra approval layers and possibly state-company procurement rules, so confirm entity and Paper Process early and keep the first ask below board level (opex or low-capex pilot).

top_3_research_highlights.finding: SQM's August 2026 guidance puts capex at about US$3B for 2026-2028, roughly 60% for Novandino, including about US$300M per year of sustaining capex across divisions; 1H2026 net income was US$1,024.7M on US$4,228.5M revenue. In Nov 2025 SQM had cut its capex estimate and postponed some investments.
top_3_research_highlights.why_ae_should_care: Money exists and sustaining capex is a natural home for inspection technology, but management is capital-disciplined. Pitch a phased, fast-payback one-site pilot sized like SQM's existing USD 70-80k deployment, not a large infrastructure ask.

recommended_case_study.title: How SQM Turned a 678 km² Mine into an Autonomous Inspection Zone
recommended_case_study.why: FlytBase's own case study about the lead's company, in the same Atacama desert conditions [S1]. Dock-based drones replaced manual field inspections at scale: inspection time cut from days to hours, >95% mission reliability, inspection frequency doubled, delivered with Chilean integrator Adentu. It is the single proof point used in Email 1. Use the Anglo American Quellaveco case study (https://flytbase.com/case-studies/anglo-american-autonomous-mining-drones-peru-case-study) [S2] as the secondary piece to acknowledge the referral (Email 3). Don't quote the iodine yield figure: the body says 2%, the headline says 4x.

gtm_motion: AE-led with partner (co-sell). The FlytBase AE owns the enterprise relationship, multi-site business case and commercials. Adentu, the Chile-based integrator that delivered SQM's FlytBase docks [S1], leads site surveys, dock install, the pilot and 24/7 local support. Dronestore Chile, a Gold System Integrator on FlytBase's partner page, is the in-country backup [S16]. UAVLatam is the referral and mining reference via Anglo American Quellaveco [S2].

suggested_next_step.rationale: Hot P1 (ICP 91, warm referral, clear cost and safety pain) inside an account that already uses FlytBase [S1]. The biggest gaps (Economic Buyer, Decision Criteria, Paper Process) only close in a live conversation. Aligning internally first avoids duplicate outreach and channel conflict with Adentu. A single-site pilot through the existing integrator fits SQM's capital discipline [S9] and reuses a proven delivery path [S1].

watch_outs: No public record of Rodrigo Castillo or a 'Northern Operations Division'. Verify his role and entity before scoping.
Public sources describe 2 main lithium sites (Salar de Atacama and the Carmen plant) [S8], not 3. The third may sit in another division.
It is November 2026, so 'Q3' may already have passed or may mean fiscal/2027. Ask; don't assume.
Adentu is not on FlytBase's public partner page [S16]. Confirm status and capacity for 3 more 24/7 sites; bringing in another integrator without aligning risks channel conflict.
The existing FlytBase deployment belongs to SQM's digital innovation team (iodine/nitrate). The lithium enquiry may have a separate budget and internal politics.
Novandino is a new JV with a Codelco-designated finance manager and joint board, which may add approval layers and state procurement rules [S7][S17].
BVLOS operations over large salar areas may need Chilean regulatory approval; docks must handle heat, dust and wind and need connectivity (the existing deployment uses Starlink [S1]).
The Feb 2026 labour-authority suspension [S30][S31] is AE context only; it was kept out of the emails on purpose. Don't raise it as a compliance failure.
Don't quote the case study's iodine yield figure until reconciled (2% in the body vs 4x in the headline).
